# Sama Alras Technical Services — Painting, Plumbing, Flooring, AC Duct Cleaning & Electrical in Dubai

> Sama Alras Technical Services is a licensed Dubai company offering five core
> services under one team: professional painting, licensed plumbing, SPC and
> other flooring, licensed electrical work, and AC duct cleaning. Free quotes, fixed pricing and a written warranty.
> Serving every Dubai community since 2013, 7 days a week (8am-10pm).

## Services

- Painting Services in Dubai (https://samalras.com/services/painting-services): villa, apartment, office/commercial and exterior building painting, plus move-in/move-out repaints and waterproofing
- Plumbing Services in Dubai (https://samalras.com/services/plumbing-services): 24/7 emergency plumber, leak detection and pipe repair, blocked drain and sewer cleaning, kitchen sink drain plumbing, water heater repair and installation, and bathroom/toilet sanitary ware installation
- SPC Flooring in Dubai (https://samalras.com/services/spc-flooring-services): supply and installation of 100% waterproof SPC flooring, plus vinyl/LVT, wooden and parquet, laminate, epoxy and carpet floors
- Electrician Services in Dubai (https://samalras.com/services/electrician-services): wiring and rewiring, light and chandelier installation, DB board and fuse box repair, switches and sockets, ceiling fans, and 24/7 emergency electrical repairs
- AC Duct Cleaning in Dubai (https://samalras.com/services/ac-duct-cleaning-services): air conditioning duct cleaning, AC coil cleaning, AC vent and grille cleaning, anti-bacterial duct sanitisation, AC servicing and filter replacement, and commercial/office HVAC duct cleaning

## Teams

Five specialist crews, all employed, trained and insured in-house rather than
day-hired per job. Full profiles on https://samalras.com/about

- Painting crew: surface-preparation specialists. Crack raking, sanding and correct primer selection for plaster, glossed woodwork or exterior render, working with Jotun, National Paints and Caparol systems.
- Plumbing team: acoustic and thermal leak detection before any wall is opened, proper drain clearing rather than punching through grease, water heater repair, and the 24/7 emergency rota.
- Flooring team: subfloor level and moisture checks before quoting, which is why most SPC flooring goes down over existing tiles without lifting them.
- Electrical team: DEWA and UAE safety standards on every job, fault diagnosis rather than part-swapping, and the 24/7 emergency rota.
- AC duct cleaning team: sealed extraction so debris leaves the property, full coil, vent, filter and drain-tray cleaning, anti-bacterial sanitising, with before/after photos of the ducts.
